props.name: maxToolRounds
props.comment: Follow-up turns after tool calls before the session gives up. Default 5.

props.name: tools
props.comment:
What the model may call, by name. A new object starts a new conversation,
so define it outside the component or memoize it.

props.name: transport
props.comment: Where the conversation goes. A new transport starts a new conversation.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.comment: Text of the button and the panel's name. Defaults to the translated "Ask".

props.name: welcomeMessage
props.comment: Shown before the first message. Defaults to the translated welcome.
